items.title: Zcash’s November upgrade could freeze funds in legacy Sprout pool
items.summary: The proposed NU7 change would disable version 4 transactions, leaving ZEC in Zcash’s legacy Sprout shielded pool unspendable.

items.title: Live updates: Bitcoin falls to $83,000 as bond yields take center stage
items.summary: U.S. bond yields are little changed early Thursday after yesterday's surge higher sent risk markets sharply lower.

items.summary: The warning brings renewed urgency to the debate over how bitcoin should deal with legacy addresses whose public keys are already exposed onchain.

items.summary: BTC price analysis concluded that onchain signals had “confirmed” the new Bitcoin bull market.

items.summary: The $2 billion digital-asset investment firm rolls out an initiative to back, build and provide liquidity to projects bringing real-world yields into DeFi.

items.summary: European regulators will map how financial firms use the technologies in client-facing products and begin checks on the most affected businesses.

items.summary: The fraudster managed to scam about 100 people across the United States, convincing them of transferring funds to him, claiming their accounts had been hacked.

items.title: Bitcoin slides to $83,300 as bond yields hit highest level since 2007
items.summary: The 10-year Treasury yield reached its highest since 2007, sending U.S. stocks and crypto lower before Asian and European traders bought the dip.

items.summary: The four-hike path is the most likely outcome, while rising bond yields and a stronger dollar weigh on bitcoin and gold.

items.summary: Washington is a mulling plan to actively promote USD-backed stablecoins worldwide in a bid to cement the greenback's global reserve status.

items.summary: A rebound in oil, the strongest U.S. business survey in five years and a poorly received five-year note sale pushed borrowing costs higher, with DOGE leading token losses.

items.summary: HIFI CEO Zach Walsh told Cointelegraph the $37 million Series A is the company’s first priced funding round, though HIFI did not disclose its valuation.

items.summary: Bybit’s global campaign positions it as a broader financial platform, though its stock, gold and forex derivatives were already available.

items.summary: Bitcoin traded near $83,200 as Fed hike odds reached about 75% and Treasury prepared a $6 billion buyback of long-dated bonds.

items.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETF inflows slowed to $347 million on Wednesday as Bitcoin fell below $84,000, while five-day inflows reached $2.65 billion.
